messages:
Dana F.: Quick flag  saw an anomalous pair of lines on a reseller AWS invoice where two different meter keys appear to bill the same usage. Posting excerpt.

Oliver R.: paste invoice id and lines?

Dana F.: INV-2025-06-22018
Excerpt:
```
Line 89: SUB-2107 | metering.dimension=prompt_tokens | qty=6,720 | charge=$67.20
Line 90: SUB-2107 | metering.dimension=prompt_token_count | qty=6,720 | charge=$67.20
```

Tara S.: that naming collision looks familiar we had a schema drift last month where partners sent both token naming variants. Billing ingest might have treated them as separate dimensions.

billing-bot: Ingest summary: marketplace-eu-west-1-usage-ingest v2025.06.22 processed 81,234 events; 24 events marked "ambiguous_meter_key".

Oliver R.: checking usage_id and raw payload for SUB-2107...

Oliver R.: both events share the same usage_id and time window, no additional metered attributes. This is almost certainly a duplicate, not additive.

Dana F.: recommended remediation and customer action? Full credit for one line?

Tara S.: credit the secondary line (Line 90) for $67.20. Also follow up with Channel Ops to notify the reseller and add note to the partner ticket. We'll avoid a blanket auto-credit until the dedupe rule is in place.

billing-bot: Proposed transform update: add normalizer step: dedupe_keys=["usage_id","subscription_id","partner_id"], preferred_meter_key_map={"prompt_tokens":"prompt_tokens","prompt_token_count":"prompt_tokens"}. Created PR 912 in billing-ingest.

Oliver R.: drafting credit memo + JE now. CM-2025-06-321 attached to partner ticket. Sending to accounting@redwood.com for signoff.

Dana F.: please also run a quick scan across the 2025-06-21..23 window to find other subscriptions with the prompt_token vs prompt_tokens pattern. Post results here.

Oliver R.: scan started. Initial results: 7 subscriptions with this exact duplication pattern; total potential exposure $412.80. Will open individual partner notes and aggregate a single JE for accounting.

Tara S.: thanks. I'll update ChannelOps ticket CH-5077 with remediation plan and PR link. Also adding a short customer-facing blurb explaining the duplicate was caused by metering key variants from AWS and that we've issued a credit.

billing-bot: Postmortem ticket PM-2025-06-meterkey-conflict created and assigned to Tara S.; due 2025-07-10.

Dana F.: leaving thread for audit. Closing once accounting confirms JE posted and credits issued.

(END)
